text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on East Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Scarborough Community Council directed Transportation Services to undertake a school safety zone review on East Avenue, fronting William G. Davis Junior Public School, and report back to Scarborough Community Council with the review findings and recommendations by Q2 2025. This report provides a summary of the assessment and improvements proposed or undertaken by Transportation Services.
City Council on April 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (March 18, 2025) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services for information.
